name: azure-resource-manager-postgresql-dotnet
summary: 微软的这份 .NET 技能指南演示如何用 C# 管理 Azure Database for PostgreSQL 灵活服务器，并提供防火墙规则、服务器配置和 Microsoft Entra ID 管理员的 SDK 示例。可先添加 Azure.ResourceManager.PostgreSql 和 Azure.Identity 包。示例仅涵盖灵活服务器的 Azure 管理操作。

Microsoft’s .NET skill shows how to manage Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server from C#, with SDK examples for firewall rules, server settings, and Microsoft Entra ID administrators. Start by adding the Azure.ResourceManager.PostgreSql and Azure.Identity packages. The examples cover Azure management operations and are scoped to Flexible Server.
